review_rules: Derive the actual hard checklist from the exact pack and audited composed selection, not this potential-target list.
Review every selected relation component together in the same saved image at its declared scale.
Partial or unobservable components fail; no cross-image composite pass.
Check the complete independent actor, object, action, consequence and artistic intent, separately from new wardrobe relations.
Requesting-user acceptance stays pending until a direct decision.
comparability: This verifies neutral authorial byte preservation. B and C change retrieval seed; their exposure delta is not a matched-seed causal comparison. Parent phase messages contain no other arm prompts/images/pack details.
